description: This Java class 'OfbizPathShortener' provides methods for creating, resolving, and restoring shortened URL paths within the OFBiz framework. It handles the generation of shortened paths, their storage, and retrieval, utilizing database mapping and hashing for efficient and secure lookups.

classes.name: OfbizPathShortener
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create, resolve, and restore shortened URL paths by mapping original paths to shortened keys stored in the database. It employs hashing for lookup efficiency and transaction management for data integrity.

methods.name: shortenPath
methods.description: Returns a shortened URL path for the given original path by appending a generated unique suffix.

methods.name: resolveShortenedPath
methods.description: Checks if a shortened path already exists for the given original path; if not, generates and records a new one.

methods.name: restoreOriginalPath
methods.description: Resolves a shortened path back to its original path, defaulting to webapp root if the original path is not found.

methods.name: resolveOriginalPathFromShortened
methods.description: Retrieves the original path corresponding to a given shortened path.

methods.name: resolveExistingShortenedPath
methods.description: Attempts to find an existing shortened path for the original path using a hash lookup.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Creates a random string based on the configured security property to serve as the shortened path suffix.

methods.name: recordPathMapping
methods.description: Stores the mapping between an original path and its shortened version within a transaction.

methods.name: generateHash
methods.description: Produces a hash of the original path for quick lookup.

methods.name: readPathMapping
methods.description: Fetches the original path associated with a given shortened path from the database.
